driver: Vehicle Track: key members trained so that by the end of Summer 2027 we can make simple modifications to the Jeep while it still runs fine
intent: Build the skills to change the vehicle safely before Year 2's larger changes
impact: Training in CAN, Simulink and CAD, plus Makerspace and Circuitspace access, comes first. The first modification stays very small, such as a simple monitor reading CAN signals: pedal position (%), engine rpm, vehicle speed (mph), battery voltage, current and temperature.
success_measure: Key members trained; a simple modification running on the Jeep by end of Summer 2027, with the vehicle still running fine

driver: Product Innovation Track: one hypothesis for Year 2 chosen, potential customers listed, and preliminary interviews done
intent: Year 2 starts from a real customer pain, not a guess
impact: Customer discovery and the Year 2 hypothesis are their own work packages. Interviews test the fit between value propositions and customer segments to find the real pain.
success_measure: One Year 2 hypothesis (a permanent, non-SDV topic), a potential-customer list and preliminary interviews by the end of Year 1

driver: Whole team: hand off leadership without starting over
intent: The work, files and sponsor contacts carry on when leads leave
impact: Successors are named early, share a spring deliverable with the outgoing lead, and find every file in one place.
success_measure: No missed deadline after any handoff
